messages:
maya: Customer asked for SLA tiers for audit exports + BYOK fallback. Need clear handshake + escrow behaviour.

jon: We can do pilot 24h tier first. Realtime needs packaging + signer + perf gating.

irene: Bundle format proposal: bundle.tar.gz -> events.ndjson + manifest.json + signer.sig (ed25519).

sam: Handshake: try key wrap for 72h. If not successful mark Escrow and encrypt with Redwood KMS, notify customer and AM.

legal: Contract notes: define "delivery" = package accepted by customer endpoint, carveouts for endpoint failures. Require consent for Redwood KMS escrow default.

jon: Ops: tag escrowed objects, generate proof-of-storage (signed timestamp + sha256), open incident ticket template. SLA clock starts on handshake success or escrow flag creation.

irene: Implementation sketch: assemble -> normalize -> sign/encrypt -> push. If BYOK present wrap with customer key; else use Redwood KMS and escrow flag.

maya: Action items: irene: manifest + example bundle (Wed). sam: draft SLA matrix + contract wording (Thu). jon: ops playbook + rate limits (Fri). maya: compile contract appendix (Fri).

sam: Deletion policy: if customer requests deletion during escrow we delete Redwood-held copy and provide signed proof-of-deletion; re-delivery later treated as new request.

maya: Sync tomorrow 9:30 to review spec.
